title: UsageObservation
description: Provider-originated bounded measurement evidence. Platform assigns TechnicalUsageEntry identity, attribution, idempotency and recorded_at after validation.
x-semantic-constraints: observation_id is idempotent within one ProviderRevision and InvocationAttempt
meter unit matches the admitted MeterDefinition and evidence_reference resolves to bytes matching evidence_digest
partial or estimated observations remain explicitly incomplete when normalized into Platform TechnicalUsage
